decision: Require consistent improvement in the primary complete-attention case across alternating source pairs before promoting the score tile to full-model timing. Inspect no-sharing controls and secondary cases; a small difference within their noise is insufficient. All samples are retained, including rejected experiments.
full_model_gate: At least 15% paired median throughput improvement versus ordinary attention in the existing Llama 3.2 1B int8 context4096/batch8/90% case; <=5% no-sharing regression, output parity, latency and lifecycle validation still required.
profiling: Separate diagnostic build; never timing-gate evidence.
prior_experiment: Unrestricted and shape-only variants are retained separately. Restricting to the sampled Llama shape and long attended prefix addresses consistent regressions in four-KV-head and shorter-context cases. Primary workload, alternating order and timing settings remain unchanged.
